cases.name: trigger_update_natural_language
cases.prompt: the goal overview numbers look stale, can you refresh it?
assertions: activates the status skill update lane
reports the change summary or 'no change'

cases.name: update_is_deterministic_and_idempotent
assertions: second run with --check exits 0 (no drift after a patch)

cases.name: artifact_data_counts_match_section_aware_grep
cases.shell_check: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && python3 .claude/skills/status/scripts/build_goal_overview.py >/dev/null && C=$(awk '/^### M[0-9]/{f=1} f' docs/goal/ROADMAP.md | grep -oE '\[x\]' | wc -l) && O=$(awk '/^### M[0-9]/{f=1} f' docs/goal/ROADMAP.md | grep -oE '\[ \]' | wc -l) && python3 -c "import json,re,sys; j=json.loads(re.search(r'id=.artifact-data.>\s*(\{.*?\})\s*</script>',open('docs/goal/goal-overview.html').read(),re.S).group(1)); t=j['roadmap_totals']; sys.exit(0 if (t['closed']==$C and t['open']==$O) else 1)"
assertions: artifact-data closed/open equal the section-aware [x]/[ ] occurrence counts from the first '### M' heading onward

cases.name: no_trigger_on_unrelated
cases.prompt: update the ROADMAP to add a new milestone
assertions: does NOT activate — editing ROADMAP/STATUS source is out of scope (one-way: markdown -> HTML)
